messages:
alina: quick flag / heads up — inbound webinar leads spiked overnight and ~78 are appearing with no owner in HubSpot :grimacing:
rahul: saw that too. Bulk came from the lightweight widget. Looks like the enrichment topic is timing out and the rr-assignment workflow skips when `owner_enriched_id` is empty
mike: why is enrichment slower now? any deploys or infra changes last night? pinging @jordan (eng-ops)
sophia: checked logs: kafka laged during the EU region deploy window around 02:10 UTC which delayed enrichment consumer by ~90s. Our assignment workflow threshold is 45s so it frequently gives up and moves leads to `fallback_inbound`
alina: action plan idea: 1) add an assignment grace window for `webinar_*` forms to 180s, 2) enable 2 retries + jitter on enrichment, 3) provisional owner flow that assigns `provisional-webinar` after 3m with a tag and reconciliation job
mike: +1. Also add a tiebreaker to round-robin so leads without enriched owner still get distributed evenly instead of piling on one SDR
rahul: I can do the RR tweak. Will add a deterministic hash fallback using `email_norm` so distribution stays even. Snippet:
```
# rr fallback
if not enriched_owner:
  owner = hash(email_norm) % len(active_sdrs)
```
jordan: deploying a quick canary for enrichment with RETRIES=2 and JITTER=true. Setting ENRICHMENT_TTL_OVERRIDE=180 for forms matching `webinar-.*`
ops-bot: Deploy succeeded: enrichment-service v4.2-canary by jordan at 1762345825
sales-bot: Created ticket MK-2021 for playbook updates and SF mapping adjustments; assigned to sophia
sophia: note: Salesforce mapping needs to ignore `provisional-*` owners so territories don't reassign incorrectly. I'll open SF-620 to add mapping rule: map `provisional-*` -> `sdr_unassigned_queue` in Salesforce sync layer
alina: short-term backfill: can we run a job to re-run enrichment for the last 36h and write owner if found? that should clean up the backlog for SDRs
rahul: yes. I'll write a backfill that is idempotent and rate-limited. Schedule after canary looks healthy. PR GH-8102
mike: SLA proposal for marketing playbook: webinar handoff: 92% assigned (provisional or final) < 2m, 99% < 8m, full reconciliation to final owner within 24h. These are tighter than the old defaults to reduce SDR jitter
sophia: I'll add those to the playbook and include runbook steps: how to flip ENRICHMENT_TTL_OVERRIDE, where to toggle provisional flag, and how to run the backfill
alina: also want an alert: Datadog `hs.webinar.unassigned.count > 40 for 10m` and another `enrichment.consumer.lag > 60s` to page eng-ops
jordan: typo — that was jordan earlier ;)
rahul: added a metric panel `webinar.assignment.latency` and alert. will link to playbook
ops-bot: Datadog monitor `enrichment.consumer.lag` triggered at 1762345900 — paging eng-ops
jordan: investigating the lag source now; canary looks ok, rolling to 20% -> 50% if no regressions in 15m
mike: once backfill runs, we should post a short note to #sdr-inbound and tag affected reps so they know owners were updated post-enrichment
sophia: will prep the SDR comms template: 1-line summary, how many leads backfilled, and any action required by reps
rahul: backfill executed at 1762345980; updated 63 leads with enriched owners and appended timeline note "backfilled post-enrichment"
ops-bot: Backfill job MK-2021 completed by rahul at 1762345980 — 63 leads updated
alina: great. follow-ups: jordan to monitor enrichment rollout, rahul to prod-verify backfill integrity, sophia to update playbook and SF mapping ticket, mike to add RR fallback test in CI
jordan: will watch for 1 hour and report metrics
mike: thanks team 44D quick triage and good layered fix (grace window + provisional + backfill + rr fallback)
